'''bounty hunter6 Carbon Freezies''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bounty hunter6]]
* '''Published:''' 14 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 CCT hunter6 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Carbon Freezing deck that needs help!!!

The published list has 67 cards.

== Strategy ==

I’m still learning more about how to play this deck… So any tips would be nice…

This deck started out as an AOTBS and then changed to a COTVG and now I think it’s going to stay put at Carbon Freezing…

First of all you can pull  Ugnaught and Carbonite Chamber and Prepare the Chamber...

The intruder missiles are never going to be played, if they are in your hand then you can play them on Colo Claw Fish lose them as lost force and if in your reserve deck they might just pop up when you need them to... The simple concept to this deck is to capture and freeze your opponents characters resulting in a force loss of 8... All the characters are destiny drawers or bounty hunters... you can retrieve force and pay less with scum and villainy which is played when you flip...you can also deploy docking bays and AC from reserve deck to flip easier (with the help of Jabba’s Prize)

Try to get Search and Destroy out and hurt your opponent (especially when he is playing a hidden base deck) If I forgot to add something tell me so more people don’t see my silly mistake...

Make sure to check out my (OK) website with the decks of my friends and mine, you can also get your decks on to the site by emailing me at the address provided...

Response to Ratings...

This deck does need tweaking but its not THAT bad...

Shewski- I know what your talking about I was just playing that deck the other day and I lost to it by 15 force because of that...

others...

I agree with your comments....
